title: GoPro joins AI bonanza with pivot into data centers as shares skyrocket 40%
summary: GoPro, a prominent action camera manufacturer, is making a significant shift by merging with Starman Optical, a private photonics company. This strategic move positions GoPro to capitalize on the burgeoning artificial intelligence sector. The company's stock has seen a remarkable surge of 40% as investors respond positively to this pivot towards data centers and AI technologies. This merger signifies GoPro's commitment to innovation and adaptation in a rapidly evolving market. As the demand for AI-driven solutions grows, GoPro aims to leverage its expertise in imaging and optics to enhance its product offerings.
